title: 2009 AMC 12B Problem 1
statement: Each morning of her five-day workweek, Jane bought either a \(50\)-cent muffin or a \(75\)-cent bagel. Her total cost for the week was a whole number of dollars. How many bagels did she buy?

solutions.text:
With \(b\) bagels she buys \(5 - b\) muffins, costing \(50(5-b) + 75b = 250 + 25b\) cents. For a whole number of dollars this must be a multiple of \(100.\) Thus \(25b\equiv50\pmod{100},\) or \(b\equiv2\pmod4.\) Since \(0\le b\le5,\) only \(b=2\) works, giving \(300\) cents \(= \$3.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: She buys \(5\) items total, so muffins and bagels together number \(5\)
The total \(50m + 75b\) cents must be a multiple of \(100;\) reduce the cost modulo \(100\)
